mapper.update: update sys_alarm_type set icon = #{icon},modifier = #{modifier},update_time = #{updateTime} where alarm_type_id = #{alarmTypeId}
update sys_alarm_type set delete_flag = '1',modifier = #{modifier},update_time = #{updateTime} where alarm_type_id = #{alarmTypeId}
mapper.select:
select u.alarm_type_id,u.alarm_source,u.type_code,u.type_name,u.icon,u.creator,u.create_time,u.modifier,u.update_time from sys_alarm_type u where u.source = '2' and u.delete_flag = '0'
AND u.alarm_source = #{alarmSource}
AND u.type_name like CONCAT('%',#{typeName},'%')
AND u.creator like CONCAT('%',#{creator},'%')
AND u.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{createBeginTime}, ' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND u.create_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{createEndTime}, ' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND u.modifier like CONCAT('%',#{modifier},'%')
AND u.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{updateBeginTime}, ' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND u.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{updateEndTime}, ' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
${dataScope} order by u.create_time desc
select count(*) from sys_alarm_type u where u.type_name = #{typeName} and u.delete_flag = '0'
